cases.artifact: test/community_board_request_responses.test.mjs :: dismissing returns focus to the control it was opened from
cases.assertion: Native inspection opens the selected request, and dismissing it returns focus to the invoking control without changing the board scope.

cases.artifact: test/community_board_request_responses.test.mjs :: print keeps the complete request reading path
cases.assertion: Print hides disclosure controls and exposes every collapsed request list so the complete reading remains available without scripting.

cases.artifact: test/community_board_request_responses.test.mjs :: keyboard inspection and translated source text
cases.assertion: Keyboard dismissal and focus containment work on the fallback path, while translated surfaces retain the publisher's source text and direction metadata.

cases.artifact: test/community_board_request_responses.test.mjs :: failed detail keeps the recovery path
cases.assertion: An unreadable register renders an explicit failure state with a retry path and does not become an empty request list.
